description: One Embed block; the variant is a block option (Embed (variant[, option])). Each variant keeps its code and styles in variants/<option>.{js,css}.

variants.usageDescription: Block Collection embed: YouTube / Vimeo / Twitter player from a URL, lazy-loaded, or click-to-play with a placeholder image. Options: narrow (fixed 1200 x 674 player, scaled down to fit), left (flush left).

Vanilla embed only handles YouTube/Vimeo/Twitter, so a Wistia-aware embed variant is needed. Reuse this for any standalone Wistia video on the product-page family.
